children: ADNOC- ADNOC UNLOCKS OVER AED60 BILLION IN UAE MANUFACTURING OPPORTUNITIES, TRANSFORMS HOW SUPPLIERS ACCESS AND COMPETE FOR ITS BUSINESS
ADNOC: NEW SUPPLIER REGISTRATION MODEL TARGETS UP TO 80% FASTER ONBOARDING AND HALVES DOCUMENTATION REQUIREMENTS
ADNOC: PROCUREMENT ENHANCEMENTS AIM TO SHORTEN PURCHASING CYCLES BY UP TO 40%
ADNOC: MANUFACTURING OPPORTUNITIES THROUGH 2030 SPAN 200 ESSENTIAL PRODUCTS AND A BROAD PORTFOLIO OF CRITICAL SPARE PARTS
ADNOC: IN ADDITION, ADNOC SIGNED TWO MOUS ON THE SIDELINES OF THE FORUM WITH THE ABU DHABI INVESTMENT OFFICE (ADIO) AND KEZAD GROUP
ADNOC- ADNOC ALSO ANNOUNCED EXPANSION OF LOCAL+ PROGRAM TO MORE THAN 100 UAE MANUFACTURERS, UP FROM 70 AT ITS LAUNCH IN MAY 2026
ADNOC- ADNOC'S ENHANCED ICV MODEL WILL MORE CLOSELY CONNECT PROCUREMENT DECISIONS WITH COMMERCIAL VALUE AND SUPPLIERS' CONTRIBUTION TO THE UAE ECONOMY
ADNOC- UNDER THE NEW MODEL, COMMERCIAL AND ICV OFFERS WILL BE INTEGRATED INTO A SINGLE EVALUATION MODEL
ADNOC- PREVIOUS BID-MATCHING APPROACH WILL BE RETIRED, ENCOURAGING SUPPLIERS TO SUBMIT THEIR MOST COMPETITIVE COMMERCIAL AND ICV OFFERS FROM OUTSET
ADNOC- NEW MODEL ALSO ENHANCES THE ADMINISTRATION OF ICV-RELATED RETENTION PAYMENTS
